title: Wifi just randomly drops out
body: Hello, I was trying to install EVE online on my arch install and I was using chatgpt to help. Omg I understand why I should never use chatgpt. However during the process my wifi card stopped working. I tried working with chatgpt to fix it and we went through a lot of things. It now works but will randomly stop working. I removed lutris and all the things that were installed after the problem started happening but it still happens. When it drops out I have to poweroff (reboot doesn't work) and power on again to get it back. I'm using a thinkpad x1 carbon and I'm only using arch on this machine. I'm also using iwl. Chatgpt had me look at some things and he made turn off powersaving mode which helped a bit but didn't solve it. Also, when the internet drops out iwctl and ip link no longer see my wireless device. He said there is a driver conflict or something. I can provide anything that would help. Sorry if I'm missing anything. I am an arch newbie. Last edited by Archedes (2025-07-14 03:10:52)
